```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
library(data.table)
library(oceancolouR)
library(raster)
library(ggplot2)
library(rasterVis)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(ncdf4)

make_map <- function(rast,title,use_lims=TRUE) {
    cm <- colorRampPalette(c("#00007F","blue","#007FFF","cyan","#7FFF7F","yellow","#FF7F00","red","#7F0000"))(100)
    canada <- map_data("world")
    p <- rasterVis::gplot(rast) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = value)) +
      geom_map(data = canada, map = canada, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, map_id=region), fill = "white", colour = "#7f7f7f", size=0.5) +
      scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=xlims) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=ylims) +
      coord_fixed(1.5) +
      theme_bw() +
      ggtitle(title) +
      theme(strip.background=element_blank(),
            strip.text=element_blank(),
            axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            axis.title.y=element_blank(),
            legend.title=element_blank(),
            legend.position="bottom",
            legend.direction="horizontal",
            legend.text=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))
    if (use_lims) {
      rvals <- values(rast)
      rmedian <- median(rvals,na.rm=TRUE)
      rsd <- sd(rvals,na.rm=TRUE)
      rlims <- c(max(0,rmedian-3*rsd),rmedian+3*rsd)
      p <- p + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cm, limits=rlims)
    } else {
      p <- p + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cm)
    }
    return(list(p,cm))
}

make_map_stack <- function(rast_stack) {
    cm <- colorRampPalette(c("#00007F","blue","#007FFF","cyan","#7FFF7F","yellow","#FF7F00","red","#7F0000"))(100)
    canada <- map_data("world")
    p <- rasterVis::gplot(rast_stack) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = value)) +
      facet_wrap(~ variable, nrow=1) +
      geom_map(data = canada, map = canada, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, map_id=region), fill = "white", colour = "#7f7f7f", size=0.5) +
      scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=xlims) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=ylims) +
      coord_fixed(1.5) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            axis.title.y=element_blank(),
            legend.title=element_blank(),
            legend.position="bottom",
            legend.direction="horizontal",
            legend.text=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))
    # if (use_lims) {
    #   rvals <- values(rast)
    #   rmedian <- median(rvals,na.rm=TRUE)
    #   rsd <- sd(rvals,na.rm=TRUE)
    #   rlims <- c(max(0,rmedian-3*rsd),rmedian+3*rsd)
    #   p <- p + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cm, limits=rlims)
    # } else {
      p <- p + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = cm)
    # }
    return(list(p,cm))
}

```

Collecting maps of input variables and the resulting PP maps using different models, for comparison:  


```{r}
xlims <- c(-95,-42)
ylims <- c(39,82)

# get input and pp for bio_v1_carla
bio_v1_input <- dplyr::bind_cols(fread("model_comparisons/BIO_v1_Carla/201807_LHTBI.csv"),
                                 fread("model_comparisons/BIO_v1_Carla/201807_pi-20141113.csv"))
rast_alphab <- var_to_rast(bio_v1_input %>% dplyr::select(Name,alphaB), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_pmb <- var_to_rast(bio_v1_input %>% dplyr::select(Name,PmB), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_chl <- var_to_rast(bio_v1_input %>% dplyr::mutate(chl=log10(chlor_a)) %>% dplyr::select(Name,chl), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
pp <- dplyr::bind_cols(bio_v1_input %>% dplyr::select(Name),
                       fread("model_comparisons/BIO_v1_Carla/201807_pp.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cppday >= 0)
rast_pp <- var_to_rast(pp %>% dplyr::select(Name, cppday), ext=c(xlims,ylims))

# get vgpm pp
rast_vgpm <- raster("model_comparisons/VGPM/vgpm.2018182.hdf")
extent(rast_vgpm) <- extent(c(xmin=-180,xmax=180,ymin=-90,ymax=90))
rast_vgpm <- crop(rast_vgpm, extent(c(xlims,ylims)))
rast_vgpm[rast_vgpm < 0] <- NA

# get biov2 pp
load("model_comparisons_biov2_test_uprofile_variablePI.rda")
finalU=final
rast_biov2U = var_to_rast(finalU %>% dplyr::select(bin, PP) %>% dplyr::rename(PP_uniformProfile=PP), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
load("model_comparisons_biov2_test_NUprofile_variablePI.rda")
finalNU=final
rast_biov2NU = var_to_rast(finalNU %>% dplyr::select(bin, PP) %>% dplyr::rename(PP_nonuniformProfile=PP), ext=c(xlims,ylims))

```


```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
r1 <- make_map(rast_alphab, "alphaB - BIO_v1 (from Carla)",use_lims=FALSE)[[1]]
r2 <- make_map(rast_pmb, "PmB - BIO_v1 (from Carla)",use_lims=FALSE)[[1]]
r3 <- make_map(rast_chl, "log10(chl) - BIO_v1 (from Carla)",use_lims=FALSE)[[1]]
# r4 <- make_map(rast_pp, "Daily PP - BIO_v1 (from Carla)")[[1]]
# r5 <- make_map(rast_vgpm, "Daily PP - VGPM")[[1]]
wrap_plots(list(r1,r2,r3),nrow=1,byrow=TRUE)
```


```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
pp_rasts1 <- stack(rast_pp, resample(rast_vgpm,rast_pp))
pp_rasts2 <- stack(rast_biov2U, rast_biov2NU)
names(pp_rasts1) <- c("Daily PP - BIO_v1 (from Carla)","Daily PP - VGPM")
names(pp_rasts2) <- c("BIOv2_uniformProfile", "BIOv2_nonuniformProfile")
ms1 <- make_map_stack(pp_rasts1)
ms2 <- make_map_stack(pp_rasts2)
ms1[[1]] + scale_fill_gradientn(colors = ms1[[2]], limits=c(0,3000))
ms2[[1]] + scale_fill_gradientn(colors = ms2[[2]], limits=c(0,200))
```
